title: Santa Stitch Naughty Or Nice? | Hong Kong Disneyland
description:
We celebrated Christmas at Hong Kong Disneyland in China. Santa Stitch was naughty & took over Tomorrow. Chris ate Hong Kong Disneyland holiday snacks and also reviewed the Main Street Corner Cafe. This rare disney character meet and greet was the highlight of the Hong Kong disney trip.
